Vanillite

Ice

Unova · Generation 5

Vanillite is an Ice-type Fresh Snow Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 5.7 kg. It evolves into Vanillish. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (65), with a base stat total of 305.
